elements.requirement: Section 668 applies if a person is liable for income tax on accrued income profits.
elements.quote: a person is liable for income tax on accrued income profits

elements.requirement: Section 668 applies if the accrued income profits are calculated by reference to payments treated as made to the person in an interest period.
elements.quote: the profits are calculated by reference to payments treated as made to the person in an interest period

elements.requirement: Section 668 applies if payments are treated as made to the person as a result of the person making transfers of foreign securities of a particular kind.
elements.quote: the payments are so treated as a result of the person making transfers of foreign securities of a particular kind

elements.requirement: Section 668 applies if the proceeds of the transfers of foreign securities are unremittable in the tax year.
elements.quote: the proceeds of the transfers are unremittable in the tax year

elements.requirement: If a person makes a claim for relief under section 668, the profits are reduced by the amount of the payments treated as made to the person.
elements.quote: the profits are reduced by the amount of the payments treated as made to the person

elements.requirement: If a person makes a claim for relief under section 668 and the amount of the payments treated as made to the person exceeds the profits, the profits are reduced to nil.
elements.quote: if that amount exceeds the profits, the profits are reduced to nil

elements.requirement: Relief under section 668 is subject to section 670 regarding the withdrawal of relief.
elements.quote: see section 670 (withdrawal of relief)

elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 668 and section 669, foreign securities means securities which are situated outside the United Kingdom.
elements.quote: “foreign securities” means securities which are situated outside the United Kingdom

elements.requirement: Proceeds of transfers of foreign securities are unremittable in relation to a person for the purposes of sections 668, 669, and 670 if the person is prevented from transferring them to the United Kingdom because of the laws of the territory where the securities are situated.
elements.quote: the laws of the territory where the securities are situated

elements.requirement: Proceeds of transfers of foreign securities are unremittable in relation to a person for the purposes of sections 668, 669, and 670 if the person is prevented from transferring them to the United Kingdom because of executive action of the government of the territory where the securities are situated.
elements.quote: executive action of its government

elements.requirement: Proceeds of transfers of foreign securities are unremittable in relation to a person for the purposes of sections 668, 669, and 670 if the person is prevented from transferring them to the United Kingdom because of the impossibility of obtaining in that territory currency that could be transferred to the United Kingdom.
elements.quote: the impossibility of obtaining there currency that could be transferred to the United Kingdom

elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 668, the place where securities are situated must be determined in accordance with sections 275(1) and (2)(b) and 275C of TCGA 1992.
elements.quote: the place where securities are situated is to be determined in accordance with sections 275(1) and (2)(b) and 275C of TCGA 1992

elements.requirement: Any claim under section 668 must be made not more than 4 years after the end of the tax year for which the profits would be chargeable to tax if no claim were made.
elements.quote: Any claim under this section must be made not more than 4 years after the end of the tax year for which the profits would be chargeable to tax if no claim were made

elements.requirement: A person's personal representatives are permitted to make any claim under section 668 which that person might have made.
elements.quote: A person's personal representatives may make any claim under this section which the person might have made

thresholds.what: the reduced amount of profits if the payments treated as made exceed the profits
